design_rationale:
TASK 0 WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — financial_assistance (Patient Financial Assistance Program), scenario env_0028_clinical_laboratory_company.

[Step 0 — draw, scope snapshot, thesis]
Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0, printed): {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}. Assignment: assistance_ext_award_discount takes 6 factors, assistance_ext_renewal_tier takes 4. Draw for task 1 (--tasks 2): prerequisite_problems 2, factor_counts [6, 6, 6].
Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: assistance_ext_award_discount (target apply_award_discount_6c746b08, event assistance_discount_applied, state_due) and assistance_ext_renewal_tier (target submit_renewal_application_d691b1b8, owner=user, event assistance_application_submitted, on_request). Left for task 1 (headroom proof): the pending-application stage — the documents request and its response period (assistance_documents_requested), the applicant's own extension request (assistance_documents_extended, the only other customer-owned act this category allows) and a tier/percent reassessment before the decision (assistance_tier_redetermined) — three disjoint events with their own calculations, so task 1 can build a 3-problem tree without touching the award-discount or renewal cores.
Thesis: the customer only asks to renew her assistance. Surface goal -> renewal tier (root, customer's own portal submission) -> prerequisite: every invoice the award covers whose payer decision is final must carry the award's discount line -> core calculation 1: the award discount on the newly final genetic-test invoice (6 factors) -> core calculation 2: the renewal tier from the unrelieved laboratory burden against the catastrophic threshold (4 factors) -> terminal state: one new discount line + raised discount total on the award + a new submitted renewal case at the right tier. Depth: 2 problems chained by a value_input edge. Breadth: invoice ledger (7 invoices, 25 lines), claim ledger (24 lines), orders (service classes, 7 orders), coverages (active individual plan + ended employer plan), payment plan and its ledger, the award's own ledger.
Why a good test: nothing in the customer's words points at the genetic-test invoice; the agent must read the renewal rule, see that its tier waits on discount lines, scan the ledgers to find the one covered final invoice without a line (and exclude the appealed molecular invoice and the three pre-award invoices), price that discount with six interacting rules, and only then assess the renewal on the updated ledger. Getting any of it wrong changes the terminal hash.

[Routing note on the base event model]
assistance_discount_applied declares a trigger into invoices (invoices_adjustment_posted). The blueprint's difficulty summary makes 'applying discounts' this category's agent action and the claimed event list includes it; the task tool writes only this category's ledger line and the case's running discount total (award_discount account) and never writes an invoices row. The seed mirrors earlier discount lines with their invoice-side financial_assistance adjustments so the historical world is consistent; the new line's invoice-side posting belongs to the invoices category's own processing and is not part of this task's scored writes.

[Base-invariant card]
Write 1 (assistance_discount_applied) — governing base policy assistance_evt_discount_application: award_approved (case ba07189c-5f0b-4b04-970a-d18b33a96cda status approved, system record, correlated by assistance_case_id = tool arg); invoice_discountable (invoice 76312eaf-061f-4497-bc9e-313ad09b0196 status open, correlated by invoice_id); once_per_invoice (award ledger has discount lines only for invoices dc9db92f-1009-436b-a185-d2e75658da04 and 42469eea-c32f-4f2c-ab1c-4d5472d21e86; none for 76312eaf-061f-4497-bc9e-313ad09b0196). Inherited unchanged: date of service inside award window (2026-05-12 in 2025-08-19..2026-10-16), eligible billing class (Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice), no claim awaiting decision or under appeal for the order (genetic claim final: contractual 2026-09-22, deductible assigned 2026-09-24, no appeal line), insured balances eligible (true for all tiers). Overwritten sentence: 'For an income or presumptive tier the discount is discount_pct percent ... limited to the balance still due.' replaced by the owed-share method (declared in overwrite). No time gate.
Write 2 (assistance_application_submitted) — governing base policies: assistance_agg_multi_holding (no gate), assistance_agg_single_open_case (one_live_case, dedup: the only live case is the approved award; renewal exception applies because frozen 2026-10-05 is within 30 days before award_end 2026-10-16, window opens 2026-09-16), assistance_tier_determination (no gate; two sentences overwritten: best-tier comparison and the hardship applicability sentence), assistance_evt_award_term_and_review_holds (no gate; channel sentence overwritten: renewals are submitted by the applicant through the portal). max_awards_per_12_months (2) is not a gate on submission; the prior award decided 2026-04-27 is the only one in 365 days. Reapplication wait after income denial does not apply (no denial).

[Business-object card]
Target of write 1: invoice 50437712 (76312eaf-061f-4497-bc9e-313ad09b0196) of order 69f7e736-8208-42ad-8df3-5fbc223a52d5 (Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing, BRCA1/2 sequencing, list 3350.00), adjudicated by coverage a1753634-4f35-482b-8764-c113b7e85111; correlation key invoice_id + assistance_case_id. Rows that enter: responsibility 2412.00 (45326def-49ef-48b3-8a7e-cc137dd663ad), courtesy 60.00 (d4f38da2-58bd-4580-a95a-21bd90c8897f), deposit payment 150.00 on the date of service (981dec05-dac8-4b52-b7ff-9ce8b1f62724); claim lines 6e3f7eb9-6679-4a00-bcbf-46dd42b4b879, cb3eb019-99a5-480e-abe9-6c8a7c7cee6e, 1a6ccea0-239b-421f-8e7c-b8bb01a8d49d. Excluded on the same customer: 50452290 (molecular, appeal filed 2026-09-08, undecided, on insurance_reprocessing hold — not discountable and not the latest assignment); 50421706 (hereditary cancer panel, date of service 2025-07-22), 50440158 (2025-08-08) and 50391247 (2025-08-12, paid) — dates of service before the award start, not covered; 50418836 and 50446031 already discounted (E3 602.00, E4 126.00).
Target of write 2: a new assistance case for customer ce7f1fe6-47bd-4709-9fba-296b33339234; the calculation reads the award being renewed (ba07189c-5f0b-4b04-970a-d18b33a96cda) and the customer's ledgers.

[Factor card — assistance_ext_award_discount (result 2226.00, fall-back with every baseline 588.00)]
1 coverage_points (parameter, cross-difficulty coverage): ladder no active coverage -> 10 / active coverage and invoice adjudicated by a plan not sponsored through an employer group (individual or government) -> 5 / otherwise 0. Tier taken: non-employer plan (COV1 not_employer_plan). Baseline 0 -> 2211.00. Near-miss: the ended employer plan COV0 (20_to_99_employees) is not the coverage on the invoice and is not active.
2 responsibility_points (parameter, cross-difficulty coverage claims): upheld patient-billable denial -> 10 / deductible -> 5 / otherwise 0. Tier: deductible (CE_O3_resp). Baseline -> 2211.00. Near-miss: the molecular order has a PR-204 denial with an appeal filed but undecided (not upheld), and its assignment is not the latest.
3 late_finalization_points (parameter, date): >180 days -> 5 / >120 and <=180 -> 3 / else 0. Evidence 2026-05-12 -> 2026-09-28 = 139 days. Baseline -> 2217.00.
4 service_class_cap (parameter, cross-difficulty orders): genetic -> 300.00 / esoteric or molecular -> 600.00 / else no cap. Tier genetic. Baseline (no cap) -> 916.56.
5 working_amount_basis (method): courtesy present -> responsibility less only billing-error and estimate adjustments / no courtesy but billing error -> less only billing error / else eligible responsibility. Tier courtesy (60.00 on 2026-09-30). Baseline eligible 2352.00 -> 2166.00.
6 discount_limit_rule (method): deposit on the date of service -> limited to working amount / prompt-pay taken and no deposit -> balance due plus prompt-pay / else balance due. Tier deposit (150.00 on 2026-05-12). Baseline balance due 2202.00 -> 2202.00.
Base boundaries inherited: eligible responsibility definition (measure), rounding to the cent, discount only under an approved award; refined: the percent (points), the amount worked on, the patient price cap, and the limit.

[Factor card — assistance_ext_renewal_tier (result 'Financial Assistance 25% Discount', fall-back 'Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment')]
1 catastrophic_share (parameter, multi-source: documented percent AND coverage; cross-difficulty coverage): >300 with active coverage -> 12.5 / <=200 with no active coverage -> 7.5 / else 10 (the hardship tier's own share). Tier: 300.3 with COV1 active -> 12.5, threshold 5875.00. Baseline 10 -> threshold 4700.00 -> hardship. Near-miss: 300.3 is only just above the band edge.
2 burden_window (method, cross-difficulty coverage dates): a coverage ended on/after the award's application date -> months since it ended + 1 / none, award runs <= 6 whole months and the latest patient responsibility posted on/after the award's application date -> the award's months / else 12. Tier: award's 6 months (COV0 ended 2024-12-31, before 2026-04-16 — the near-miss). Baseline 12 months also counts 560.00 posted 2025-12-15 (invoice 50391247) -> burden 6160.00 -> hardship.
3 amount_in_question (parameter): invoice on insurance-reprocessing hold -> its responsibility in window / dispute hold only -> its balance due / else 0. Tier: 50452290 on hold, 565.00. Baseline 0 -> 6165.00 -> hardship.
4 plan_carried_balances (parameter, cross-difficulty plans): active plan with no missed installment in 6 months -> installments paid taken out / defaulted plan -> returned-payment fees added / else 0. Tier: plan 4ac686f1-1f36-4a33-a533-698073b3720d active, 4 x 70.00 = 280.00 paid, none missed. Baseline 0 -> 5880.00 -> hardship.
Fall-back (every baseline): share 10, 12 months, nothing taken out -> hardship. Task floors: multi-source = catastrophic_share; cross-difficulty = coverage_points, responsibility_points, service_class_cap, catastrophic_share, burden_window, plan_carried_balances; cross VALUE reads (CPARAM/CFIELD/XSUM/XCOUNT/XLATEST) in both computations.

[Problem-tree card]
Root: assistance_ext_renewal_tier (owner=user tool). Prerequisite: assistance_ext_award_discount (owner=agent). Edge kind value_input, gate binding window_relief, form state. Prerequisite sentence (renewal rule): 'The tier a renewal application is assessed at is set only after every invoice the award being renewed covers whose payer decision is final carries that award's discount line.' Four-point test: (1) 'only after' joins this policy's result (the tier) to what it waits on, affirmative direction — the way a renewals desk states it ('we set your renewal once every bill your award covers has its discount'); (2) the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a discount line per covered final invoice on the award's ledger); (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) strength 'only after', scope 'every invoice ... whose payer decision is final' — exactly the condition field. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: the award-discount booking (the only writer of assistance_discount_applied lines). Derivation: sentence + find_assistance_events (lines only for 50418836 and 50446031) + find_claim_events/find_invoices (genetic invoice final, covered, unlined) + the award-discount rule ('the award discount on that invoice is fixed ...') -> book the award discount on 50437712, then assess.
Unmet at frozen_time: 45326def-49ef-48b3-8a7e-cc137dd663ad posted 2026-09-28; 1a6ccea0-239b-421f-8e7c-b8bb01a8d49d deductible final; award lines 7db7adad-edca-4141-9357-6e759d446308 -> dc9db92f-1009-436b-a185-d2e75658da04, 7cdc9f91-6728-4bbd-96ca-24d8a5ef0cbf -> 42469eea-c32f-4f2c-ab1c-4d5472d21e86; no line for 76312eaf-061f-4497-bc9e-313ad09b0196.
Topological order: award discount (step 12) -> renewal (step 14). Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skipping step 12 leaves window_relief 728.00, burden 7826.00 > 5875.00, renewal tier 'Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment'.
user_scenario mentions no invoice, discount or bill; only the passive 'if the agent tells you that something on your account has to be taken care of ... go ahead'. Tools validate nothing (both are single ctx writes).

[Persona design]
Renata Vossberg, organised dispatcher, opens with the renewal in one line; identity (phone 4045553186, DOB 1981-06-14, ZIP 30318, email) only when asked; household 1 / income $47,000 / insured (Peachtree Marketplace Silver HSA 3300) only when asked; passive go-ahead for whatever has to be handled first; runs the portal submission herself when handed it, entering exactly the program, reference number, 1, 47000.00 and insured; never chooses the program herself; closes after the confirmation. She volunteers no fact that only gold creates and asks for nothing else.

[Seed rows — why each exists]
customers (identity); coverages COV1 (active individual plan: coverage points, active-coverage test) and COV0 (ended employer plan: burden-window near-miss); orders (7; list totals built from the test menu: hereditary cancer panel 4150.00, BRCA 3350.00, esoteric five-test order 1022.00, toxicology 787.00 and 976.00, pathology 400.00, molecular PCRs 565.00); claim_events (latest assignment selects the target, the upheld appeal on the 2025 panel, the undecided appeal on the molecular claim, responsibility types, remittance arithmetic billed = contractual + responsibility or denied); invoices and their ledger (burden window postings 9459.00 in 6 months + 560.00 older, courtesy, deposit, financial-assistance mirror adjustments, portal payments); payment plan PL1 + ledger (plan credit 280.00); award case A + ledger (documents, two earlier discount lines priced by this charter's award-discount rule: 602.00 and 126.00). Removing COV1 or the individual band changes coverage points; removing the deposit line changes the limit; removing the courtesy line changes the working amount; removing PL1 rows changes the plan credit and flips the tier; removing the hold on I4 flips the tier.
Automatic clauses checked: award expiry is 2026-10-16 (after frozen time); no document deadline open; plan current (no missed installment); invoice holds: I4 insurance_reprocessing since 2026-09-08 within its 60-day limit; no collections. No cache trap is used (discount_granted_total 728.00 equals the ledger: 602.00 + 126.00).

[Standard solution]
Locate (phone) -> verify (phone + DOB) -> read case, award ledger, invoices, invoice ledger, claim ledger, orders, coverages, plan, plan ledger -> unlock + call apply_award_discount_6c746b08(assistance_case_id=ba07189c-5f0b-4b04-970a-d18b33a96cda, invoice_id=76312eaf-061f-4497-bc9e-313ad09b0196, discount_amount=2226.00) -> unlock_user_discoverable_tool(submit_renewal_application_d691b1b8) and hand over -> the customer calls it with (customer_id=ce7f1fe6-47bd-4709-9fba-296b33339234, variant_name='Financial Assistance 25% Discount', household_size=1, annual_household_income=47000.00, insurance_status='insured').
Award discount: pct 25+5+5+3 = 38; working 2412.00; cap 300.00; owed RND(300.00 x 0.62) = 186.00; 2412.00 - 186.00 = 2226.00; limit 2412.00 (deposit) -> 2226.00.
Renewal: window 6 months; burden 9459.00 - 60.00 - (602.00 + 126.00 + 2226.00) - 565.00 - 280.00 = 5600.00 <= 5875.00 -> tier of the award being renewed.

[Verification run (handling-time, replaying gold writes)]
Commands: check_extended / check_task_tools / replay_tasks / check_solvability / check_compute / check_grounding / check_cross_fire with --task 0 -> EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (15 actions, deterministic, closure equals initial_state), SOLVABILITY OK (7 base gates), COMPUTE OK (10 factors, 6 cross-difficulty), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK. Recompute output: award discount 2226.0 (factor baselines 2211.0, 2211.0, 2217.0, 916.56, 2166.0, 2202.0; all-baseline 588.0); renewal tier 'Financial Assistance 25% Discount' after the line (each factor baseline and the all-baseline give 'Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment'; without step 12 also hardship). The runnable entry point is skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py <diff> --task 0, which replays gold writes and recomputes every binding.

[Revisions]
1) Symptom: first world used an out-of-network plan with a 2480.00 genetic balance; root cause: the coverage charter caps out-of-network patient balances at the self-pay price (349.00 for the genetic test), so the balance contradicted another product; change: in-network individual high-deductible plan, deductible 2412.00 on allowed amount, coverage-points ladder re-based on individually bought vs employer plans, responsibility-points ladder on deductible vs upheld denial; re-run: values above.
2) Symptom: check_compute flagged working_amount_basis as reading no records; change: its evidence bindings (courtesy and billing-error sums) were assigned to the factor. 3) Symptom: forcing cross-category reads off left the renewal tier unchanged; root cause: an EXISTS guard made the ended-coverage test never read the coverage date; change: the burden-window test compares the ended coverage's date with the award's application date directly. Re-run: COMPUTE OK.
4) Symptom: list totals of the esoteric, specialty, molecular and pathology orders exceeded what the orders test menu can produce, and the two earlier award discount lines had been priced at a flat 25 percent; root cause: amounts chosen before the menu and this charter's own discount rule were applied to history; change: every order total rebuilt from menu list prices, household reduced to 1 (income 47000.00, percent 300.3) so the burden test sits near its threshold, the earlier discount lines repriced by the award-discount rule (602.00 with the esoteric cap, 126.00 at 35 percent), plan rebased to a 6-Month plan of 420.00; re-run: award discount 2226.00 unchanged, renewal burden 5600.00 vs 5875.00, every factor flips the tier.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context]
Masking compute/GT: the published renewal rule says the tier waits on discount lines for every covered final invoice; the ledgers show exactly one such invoice without a line; the award-discount rule with its six ladders prices it at 2226.00 from the visible ledger rows; the renewal rule with its four ladders then yields 5600.00 against 5875.00 -> the award's own tier. Same object, order and values as gold; no second reading found (the molecular invoice is excluded by the base adjudication-first condition, the pre-award invoices by the award window).

[Round 2 — audit items closed]
T0-1: the read-step objective for find_assistance_cases now states the seeded household (1), income (47,000.00) and percent (300.3); the seed-rows note states discount_granted_total 728.00 (602.00 + 126.00); the breadth line states 24 claim lines. Every other world assertion of this file was re-swept against initial_state (household, income, percent, discount totals, line counts, plan figures) and agrees.
O-1: the coverage-points tier now says what the machine tests — a plan not sponsored through an employer group (individually bought or government) — and the points are renamed non-employer-plan points; same tier and value here.
O-2: the burden window no longer compares a missing coverage date: an absent ended coverage reads as no ended coverage, so a renewing household with no ended coverage evaluates normally (checked on this world with the ended coverage removed). The award-term tier now also requires that the household's latest patient responsibility was posted on or after the award's application date (the award's own term reflects the burden only when billing continued during it); here the latest posting is 2026-09-28, so the tier and every figure are unchanged.
O-6: the baseline sentence now reads 'The award discount is limited to the invoice's balance still due' (no 'never'), so the deposit tier refines it without contradiction.
O-T0-1 (observation): kept by design — the renewal's fall-through is the award's own tier; discrimination rests on the 2226.00 discount write and on every renewal factor's baseline flipping to the hardship adjustment.
Re-run: all per-task gates OK; computed values unchanged.

[Round 3 — audit items closed]
R2-F1: the countable-percent rule now applies only to a submitted application that carries no documents-requested date 'and is not a renewal application (one submitted while the household's award is approved)', and states that a renewal application keeps the tier its renewal assessment gave it (declared in that policy's overwrite of the base redetermination sentence). The document-period rule now states, inside its declared replacement of the base due-date sentence, that a renewal application on which the applicant reports no change of household or income relies on the documents already received for the award being renewed and needs no documents request. On this world the customer's renewal is submitted while award ba07189c is approved and she states that her household (1) and income ($47,000) are unchanged and her coverage is the same, so after her submission no reassessment and no documents request falls due on the new case: the transaction ends with the renewal at Financial Assistance 25% Discount, as in gold.
R2-O1 (observation): (a) closed in round 2; (b) the latest-posting conjunct reads the household's latest responsibility posting, which exists for every household that holds an approved award (an award is approved only when the patient has an invoice it could discount, and every invoice's amount arrives as a responsibility posting); here it is 2026-09-28; (c) this world holds exactly one ended coverage (ended 2024-12-31), so the singular 'the household's ended coverage' reads one row.
Re-run: all gates OK; computed values unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Renata Vossberg, 45, a school transportation dispatcher in Atlanta who lives on her own, keeps her paperwork in a folder and likes to get things done before deadlines. You are calling Halverson Clinical Laboratories Patient Services on a Monday morning because the financial-assistance discount you were approved for in April (you remember it as the 25 percent discount) runs out in the middle of October, and you want to renew it today so it does not lapse. That renewal is the whole reason for the call; you open with it in plain words, something like: I'd like to renew my financial assistance before it runs out this month. You do not know how the laboratory decides which assistance program you get and you never suggest one yourself; if the agent asks which program you want, you say you have no idea how that works and you will go with whatever the agent tells you applies. You give your details only when the agent asks for them: your phone number is 4045553186, your date of birth is 1981-06-14 (you say it as June 14, 1981 and repeat it as 1981-06-14 if the agent wants the digits), your ZIP code is 30318 and your email is renata.vossberg@peachmail.net. Only when the agent asks about your household and income do you say that it is still just you, a household of 1 person, and that your income has not changed: $47,000 a year, the same figure you gave in April. Only when the agent asks about insurance do you say that you still have your marketplace plan, the Peachtree Marketplace Silver HSA 3300, so you are insured; you have had no other change in coverage this year. If the agent tells you that something on your account has to be taken care of before the renewal can be set up, you tell them to go ahead and do it, and you wait while they do; you do not ask for details beyond what they offer and you do not dispute the amount they mention. If the agent tells you that a renewal has to be submitted by you yourself through the patient portal and hands that step to you, you do it right away in the same call, entering exactly the program name the agent gives you together with your customer reference number as the agent reads it to you, your household size of 1, your annual household income of 47000.00 and insured as your insurance status; if the agent has not told you which program to enter, you ask them which one before submitting, and you never pick one yourself. After you submit, you read back the confirmation you see on the screen if the agent asks. You have no other request today and you do not raise any other bill or question. Once you have submitted the renewal and the agent confirms it went through, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's patient profile from the phone number she states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and both writes need her customer reference number; locating comes before verification.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the in-session identity check with the two details she states (phone number and date of birth).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No record may be discussed or changed before identity is verified; two matching details are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her assistance cases: the approved Financial Assistance 25% Discount award, its application date, award window (2025-08-19 to 2026-10-16), documented household of 1, income 47,000.00, documented percent 300.3 and the discount granted so far.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the award is approved and inside its renewal window (one-live-case exception), and supplies the documented income and percent, the award's application and end dates (burden window) and the tier the renewal falls back to.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the award's activity: the documents received and the discount lines already booked (on the esoteric invoice on 2026-05-08 and the pathology invoice on 2026-07-17), with no line for the genetic-test invoice.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Proves the newly final genetic-test invoice still lacks its award discount line (the unmet prerequisite of the renewal tier) and gives the discounts dated within the burden window.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every invoice: dates of service (three of them before the award start 2025-08-19), statuses, balances, the insurance-reprocessing hold on the molecular invoice, the plan-carried esoteric invoice and the coverage each invoice was adjudicated by.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identifies which invoices the award covers, the hold that takes an amount out of the burden, and the genetic-test invoice's date of service and coverage for its discount.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every invoice ledger line: responsibility postings and their dates, the courtesy adjustment and the deposit on the genetic-test invoice, statements, payments and the financial-assistance adjustments.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the working amount, balance still due, deposit and late-finalization span of the discount, and the responsibility and adjustments posted within the burden window.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the claim ledger: which order's patient responsibility was assigned most recently (the genetic test, a deductible on 2026-09-24), the undecided appeal on the molecular claim and the other remittances.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Selects the invoice the discount is fixed for, its responsibility points, and shows the molecular claim is still under appeal (not discountable).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the orders behind the invoices, in particular the service class of the genetic-test order.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The service class decides the patient price cap of the award discount.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her coverages: the active individually bought marketplace plan and the employer plan that ended on 2024-12-31.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the coverage points (individual plan), the catastrophic share (active coverage) and shows no coverage ended during the award being renewed (burden window).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her payment plan: the active 6-Month Payment Plan carrying the esoteric invoice.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: An active plan with no missed installment lets its paid installments come out of the burden.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the plan ledger: enrollment and four installments paid, none missed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the installments paid (280.00) and proves no installment was missed in the last six months.
First half of the unlock/call pair for the prerequisite write; no DB effect; unlocked once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the approved award's discount of 2,226.00 on the genetic-test invoice 50437712, whose deductible became final on 2026-09-24.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The award owes this discount (state_due) and the renewal tier is set only after every final covered invoice carries the award's discount line; the amount is uniquely produced by the award-discount policy.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.assistance_case_id: Value ba07189c-5f0b-4b04-970a-d18b33a96cda. Basis: the award-discount rule 'the award discount on that invoice is fixed for the invoice of the order the payer most recently assigned a patient responsibility to' applies to 'an approved award', and the tool docstring asks for 'the reference number of the approved assistance case (the award) under which the discount is booked, as returned by the assistance-case lookup'; find_assistance_cases returns exactly one case for the customer, status approved (Financial Assistance 25% Discount, award 2025-08-19 to 2026-10-16). Uniqueness: it is the only approved (indeed the only) case on file, and the invoice's date of service 2026-05-12 lies inside its window.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.invoice_id: Value 76312eaf-061f-4497-bc9e-313ad09b0196 (invoice number 50437712). Basis: the rule fixes the discount 'for the invoice of the order the payer most recently assigned a patient responsibility to'; find_claim_events shows the latest coverage_patient_responsibility_assigned line is 2026-09-24 on the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing order 69f7e736-8208-42ad-8df3-5fbc223a52d5, and find_invoices returns invoice 76312eaf-061f-4497-bc9e-313ad09b0196 for that order. Factors: coverage points 5 (active individually bought plan a1753634-4f35-482b-8764-c113b7e85111, employer_group_size_band not_employer_plan, adjudicated the invoice); responsibility points 5 (final responsibility is a deductible, claim line 1a6ccea0-239b-421f-8e7c-b8bb01a8d49d); late-finalization points 3 (139 days from date of service 2026-05-12 to posting 2026-09-28, more than 120 and not more than 180); award discount percent 25 + 5 + 5 + 3 = 38; working amount 2412.00 (courtesy adjustment 60.00 present, so only billing-error and estimate adjustments, both 0, come off); genetic price cap 300.00 (order class Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing); owed share RND(min(2412.00, 300.00) x 62 / 100, 2) = 186.00; discount before limit 2412.00 - 186.00 = 2226.00; limit = working amount 2412.00 because a 150.00 payment was posted on the date of service (deposit); booked min(2226.00, 2412.00) = 2226.00. argument_uniqueness_tracing.variant_name: Value 'Financial Assistance 25% Discount'. Computed by the renewal-tier policy on the ledger after the discount line is booked: catastrophic share 12.5 (documented percent 300.3 above 300 with an active coverage), threshold RND(47000.00 x 12.5 / 100, 2) = 5875.00; burden window 6 whole months (no coverage ended on or after 2026-04-16; the award runs 6 months); burden 9459.00 - 60.00 - 2954.00 - 565.00 (invoice on insurance-reprocessing hold) - 280.00 (installments paid on the active plan, none missed) = 5600.00, not greater than 5875.00, so 'otherwise it is assessed at the tier of the award being renewed'. Uniqueness: the remaining enum values are excluded — Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment because the burden does not exceed the threshold; the 50%, 75% and Full income tiers and Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount because the policy assigns either the hardship adjustment or the tier of the award being renewed, and that award is the 25% tier.
